description: s441 fix round (review:S441-f4f5-review). Since s441 a handler that calls a server function awaits it and runs as an async function. `event.preventDefault()` placed AFTER that call now runs after the handler has yielded — the browser has already submitted the form (reviewer-executed: defaultPrevented false; true before s441). The compiler refuses it rather than silently letting the form submit, and does not move the call (a conditional preventDefault would change meaning). (s457 3a: the handler takes the event as the parameter of a `${(event) => { … }}` listener — a compiler-wrapped handler does not bind `event`, SPEC §5.2.)
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 10 (g-boot-event-cases-unhandled-server-call-s478)
rationale: §13.2: preventDefault / stopPropagation / stopImmediatePropagation on the handler's event parameter after its first await SHALL be a compile error (E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT, §34). (S478 open-Qs ruling item 10: the server call is written as a handled statement — `const ok: bool = isOk(1) !{ _ :> false };` then `@verdict = ok ? … : …;` — since §19.9.10 makes an unhandled client call of a server function E-ERROR-002; the case's point is unchanged.)
